description: The Fawn Creek Recreation Trails offer approximately 19 km of maintained recreation trails, the majority of which follow old non-status roads. The trails are a popular destination for horseback riding, hiking, and snowmobiling.
directions: From 100 Mile House, travel approximately 8 km south on Hwy 97 and turn east onto Hwy 24. Follow Hwy 24 for approximately 24.7 km and turn left/north onto Fawn Creek Road. There are several spots to access the trails off Fawn Creek Road. Alternatively, the trails may be accessed via Horse Lake Road, near the east end of Horse Lake.

stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - South Cariboo - Chilcotin - Central Coast

title: Fawn Creek Recreation Trails
